description: Interactive IMU-controlled water and fire simulator

store.summary: Interactive water and fire simulations that react to every tilt.
store.description: Turn your CardputerZero into a pocket-sized physics display. Tilt and shake the device to move a volume-preserving water simulation with fluid inertia, or switch to a full-width combustion field where flames and embers bend with gravity while retaining their upward jet. Note: CardputerZero Lite does not include an IMU, so the interactive experience is limited on that model.
